segments.text: We first tried Digital marketing tools in 209. At the time, competition mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Maiduguri, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Digital marketing tools—we saw Reduced stock-outs within 9 months.
Policy-wise, CBN cashless policy shaped our move. We adjusted by Bundle financing.
Data helped; even a simple regression model gave us clearer demand patterns during Back-to-school.
